notes: I changed the append rule: the box appends 'h' only when the input contains no lowercase 'h' (case-sensitive), rather than based on the last kept character. This explains E4's "hello hello"→"helo ", "the cat sat"→"the cas", and "abcdefghij"→"abcdefghij" (all contain lowercase h, so no append), while "Hello"→"Heloh" still appends because it only has uppercase 'H'.
